_note: Per-world dressing. Palettes are data, not code: neither renderer knows there is more than one world. Every colour here MULTIPLIES a vertex colour (MeshLambertMaterial.color over vertexColors), so home is the identity and elsewhere is a shift of the same drawing, not a second set of assets.
_elsewhereNote: The sunset is the portal's cutout palette (render/portal.js drawMouth), so the place is visibly the one you have been seeing through the mouth all along. Ground shifted violet, foliage shifted violet-red, the stream water lit from inside. No sea.
_glowNote: terrainGlow / foliageGlow are ADDED (Lambert emissive), because a multiply on green ground can only make brown: the first elsewhere frame was the same forest in a brown filter, and only the rocks read as violet. Home's are black.
